chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Kick cramp and Bill Bailey's walking cramp
summary: Green demonstrates Bubbles' kick cramp and Bill Bailey's walking cramp, and says he now varies steps up to Take the A Train with the hoofers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: (Tap dancing.) That's a kick cramp. You

So some years later I met Mr. Bill Bailey, and he had come along with a different way of doing a Bubbles tap step, which was a cramp. But Mr. Bailey did it down on the floor with the whole foot. He didn't kick it. He didn't kick the cramp. He

walked it, see. That was something like this. (Tap dancing.) That's a walking cramp. (Tap dancing.) Hear all the taps? That's a cramp. It's a cramp rhythm. (Tap dancing) See, Bubbles'? Bailey's. (Tap dancing.) Like that, see. That's a kick cramp. A kick cramp and the walking cramp, see. So there now, I figured that's a good idea. I better continue change it to teach myself different ways of doing Mr. Bubbles' tap steps. And that's what I have done up to this day, until I got to the "A Train". So now I'm on the "A Train", with the hoofers.
Well, we'll have a chance to hear that later. When we get up to that period.
